title: Casussy
excerpt: iOS app to run a household together: chores, groceries, the weekly menu and expenses, shared in real time.

data.text: A native app for people who live together: chores, the grocery list, the weekly menu and shared expenses, visible to everyone as soon as someone adds or ticks something.
I designed it in SwiftUI with offline persistence and a lightweight backend for sync, with an invite system to add the people you live with.

image_captions: Casussy dashboard with task management, shopping and weekly menu for the household
